queries.exists: SELECT 1 FROM programs WHERE name = 'Google Drive' AND publisher = 'Google LLC';
queries.patched: SELECT 1 WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM programs WHERE name = 'Google Drive' AND publisher = 'Google LLC' AND version_compare(version, '133.0.2.0') < 0);
queries.open: SELECT 1 WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM processes WHERE LOWER(name) = 'google drive.exe');
